description: Static registry for custom SVG icons. Consuming applications call or in their Program.cs before the app starts. // Program.cs IconRegistry.Register("my-logo", "<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24'>...</svg>"); // or IconRegistry.RegisterProvider(new MyFontIconProvider());

members.name: Contains
members.description: Returns if the icon name exists in the direct registry or in any registered provider.

members.name: Register
members.description: Registers an inline SVG string for the given icon name. The should be the inner content of the <svg> tag (i.e. path, circle, etc. elements — NOT the <svg> wrapper). Case-insensitive: "MyIcon" and "myicon" resolve to the same entry.

members.name: RegisterProvider
members.description: Registers a custom . Providers are consulted in registration order after the direct registry.

members.name: Resolve
members.description: Resolves SVG content for the given icon name. Checks direct registry first, then registered providers in order. Returns when not found anywhere.
